hooks.name: Guard dependencies, pushes and deploys
hooks.description: Before the agent runs a shell command or writes a file, block anything that adds or upgrades a dependency (npm install, npm add, yarn add, pnpm add, or an edit to package.json or package-lock.json), pushes to a remote, or deploys. Exit code 2 blocks the call and the reason goes back to the agent. A person makes those changes by hand.
